results.overview: It’s a mockumentary-style short film set in a typical office environment. The story revolves around a male employee who suddenly receives a complaint under the POSH Act (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) at the workplace. The narrative uses a mix of Tamil and English, and leans heavily on sarcasm and comedic beats—breaking the fourth wall, the protagonist talks directly to us, the “camera”, offering his reactions and thoughts in a funny, self-aware manner.
results.title: POSH (Please only send help)
